faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Edulato

items.question: How much does Edulato cost?
items.answer: We offer a free plan to get started, with paid plans starting at $99/month. You can see all pricing details on our pricing page.

items.question: Can I migrate my existing courses?
items.answer: Yes! We offer free migration support for courses from other platforms. Our team will help you transfer everything seamlessly.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to use Edulato?
items.answer: Not at all. Edulato is designed to be user-friendly. If you can use email, you can use Edulato.

items.question: What payment methods do you support?
items.answer: We support all major credit cards, PayPal, and local payment methods in 135+ countries.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. There are no long-term contracts or hidden fees.
